chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The location of the grave of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, is a channel from the channels of Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the exalted status of the grave of al-Husayn عليه السلام by describing its location as one of the channels of Paradise. It indicates the sacredness and heavenly connection of his resting place within Shia tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3208 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The location of the grave of al-Husayn (as) is a channel from the channels of Paradise."
